title: docs: define model API surface policy
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Requires a separate, explicit confirmation before any public endpoint, method, transport, schema, streaming, or event change.
- Requires every API-surface proposal to state the concrete user/developer problem, current and proposed contracts, compatibility impact, affected clients, and migration plan.
- Resolves compatibility patterns in order: current official OpenAI API, then current OpenRouter contract when OpenAI has no equivalent, then an explicit API-contract decision.
- Keeps `/v1` strictly standard-compatible, provider protocols internal, and native/compatible routes on one shared implementation.
- Prevents endpoint fragmentation and unrelated operations being combined only through model selection.

Validation:
- Model-management skill validation passed
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: One door for every route
gist.blurb: The hive wrote down where new API doors belong before somebody installs three nearly identical ones. `/v1` stays tidy; the provider machinery remains safely behind the wall.
gist.summary: Added an internal model-management policy requiring explicit confirmation, compatibility analysis, affected-client review, and a migration plan before changing any public endpoint, transport, schema, streaming behavior, or event contract.
gist.impact: Future API changes will consistently prioritize the official OpenAI contract, use OpenRouter only when needed, keep `/v1` standard-compatible, and avoid fragmented model-specific routes.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden architect at a single well-marked API gateway, comparing two neat route maps labeled OpenAI and OpenRouter before planting one shared code-vine path; a cozy terminal and small flowers emphasize orderly internal infrastructure rather than a public feature launch.
